# GMEOW Software Module

The GMEOW Software Module — classes, properties, and individuals of the GMEOW super-vocabulary.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/software>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:slices/software`  

**Type:** `owl:Ontology`  

The software slice: a five-facet de-conflation of the project domain.

Project ≠ Product ≠ Codebase ≠ Repository ≠ History.

Each facet is separately identified, separately classed, and never bridged by
subclassing or equivalence. DOAP's original sin — collapsing endeavour, product,
repo, and history into one class — is corrected here; DOAP is aligned by reference
as a lossy downcast, never imported (Principle 5).

REUSE.
- Events / Participation / Activity: events.ttl, provenance.ttl
- Contribution / ContributionRole: creative-works.ttl
- VersionSet / VersionMembership: versions.ttl
- Attestation / CryptographicSignature: attestation.ttl, trust.ttl
- contentDigest / versionFingerprint: sources.ttl, versions.ttl
- Temporal / standpoint / displayable: temporal.ttl, standpoint.ttl, core.ttl

The flat property gmeow:developer is REMOVED (Principle 6 — greenfield); the
Contribution relator and hasContributor shortcut supersede it.

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/software>
